notes: The postural 'lies' mints no event, 'at' routes to LocatedIn, the part-whole of-phrase to PartOf, 'near' keeps the entity-attached surface preposition, and the multi-word name gets one opaque symbol with its Name plus a separate kind atom and no modifier genus. 'near the Cove Stair' is attached low (to the cliff) rather than to the seam or the base; the sites are truth-conditionally near-identical here, so a single reading is the correct default.
